items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 15 June 2026 5:29am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Monday, 15 June 2026 at 5:30am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Nil.


##Synopsis##

High pressure near Iceland extending a ridge across much of the British Isles.


##Wind##

East or southeast 4 or 5, soon decreasing 2 to 4, veering south or southwest later.


##State of Sea##

Slight occasionally moderate at first, falling smooth or slight later.


##Weather##

Mainly fair, risk of patchy rain later today, then a risk of mist and fog patches overnight.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate in any rain, poor or very poor in any mist and fog patches later.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

South or southwest 2 to 4, increasing 5 in places, veering west or southwest later.


##State of Sea##

Smooth or slight, becoming slight occasionally moderate later.


##Weather##

Risk of mist and fog patches, rain later.


##Visibility##

Moderate or good, falling poor in mist and very poor in fog patches.
